matchupOfTheWeek.title: Rush Offense vs. Run Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our rush offense grades 65/100 (above average) against BUF's run defense at 6/100 (among the NFL's worst) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing about this Buffalo trip: we've got a sledgehammer (our rushing attack at 65/100) meeting a glass door (their run defense at 6/100), and that mismatch is the widest edge we'll see all week. The problem is everything else looks decidedly less appetizing — our pass offense is genuinely struggling at 23/100, our pass protection is a tire fire at 16/100, and we're walking into a stadium where they've got one of the league's best pass rushes (61/100) and the second-best offense in the league overall. We're also coming off three games where we've been a tick below water (-0.11 EPA/play) while Buffalo's been slightly profitable (0.14), and they're favored by a touchdown at home for a reason. If we can't establish the run game decisively and keep Drake Maye from beating himself like he did against Jacksonville, this one gets away from us quick.
